About.title: Hi, I’m Monika.
About.lead: I started as a <hl>UGC creator</hl> and discovered how much <hl>authenticity, storytelling and timing</hl> matter for content people actually want to watch.
About.body1: Today I combine that experience with <hl>AI production</hl> and professional post-production. That lets me help brands with natural UGC content, cinematic <hl>AI commercials</hl> and strong product photos for social media, ads and <nw>e-commerce</nw>.
About.body2: For each project I choose what works best: UGC for trust and connection, AI when an idea can be bigger, faster or more visual, or a <hl>combination of both</hl> when that gives the strongest result. I guide the whole process — from concept and visual direction to production, editing and delivery.
About.ctaBody: Tell me about your product or brand — in a free intro call we’ll find out what fits.
About.closing: My approach is personal, clear and focused on content that doesn’t just look good, but is genuinely useful for your brand.

turnaround.question: What is the typical turnaround time?
turnaround.answer: <hl>One video</hl>: usually 3–5 business days after the creative direction and required input have been approved. For several videos or custom work, we agree on the planning together upfront. Turnaround times are indicative and may vary depending on feedback, complexity and available assets.

product.question: Will the AI video match my physical product?
product.answer: I work from your real product images and oversee brand alignment and colour grading, so the final result matches the creative direction agreed upfront.

ads.question: Can I use the content in ads?
ads.answer: Usage rights are agreed clearly per project. Use on your own channels can be part of the package. Paid advertising, whitelisting or broader commercial use may require additional agreements.

revisions.question: How do revisions and delivery work?
revisions.answer: The fixed video packages include two revision rounds per video; for custom work we agree on this upfront. I guide the project from the first brief through sound design and final export. I deliver content in the format and resolution that suit the platform and project. 4K can be agreed when the source material and production allow it.

payment.question: How do payment and onboarding work?
payment.answer: A <hl>50% deposit</hl> is paid at the start. The remaining amount is paid before or at final delivery, according to the agreed project terms.
